title: Translation - Data API
description: The Translation object represents the languages enabled for translation in your Salesforce org. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

CanManage.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
CanManage.description: Indicates whether the language is available for translation (true) or not (false).Specify translators for each language through the Translation Language Setup page.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the translated values for this language display to users (true) or not (false).

Language.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Language.description: The language code. See the Salesforce Help for a full list of languages and their codes.

special_access_rules:
Your organization must be using Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, or Developer
            edition.

To view this object, you must have the “View Setup and Configuration” permission.

calls,
            Translation Workbench must be enabled in your org.

To manage translations, Translation Workbench must be enabled in your org. Specify
            translators for each language through the Translation Language Settings Setup page.
wsdl_segment:

<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="Translation">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CanManage" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="IsActive" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="Language" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
